expected_behavior: 调用 analyze_threat_incident 一次，快速分类成功时只交付与工具 result 完全一致的 JSON，其他情况交付完整工具 JSON；根据实时名单允许 fast_classification 或 five_source。五源若合同拒绝，必须返回 contract_failed 且没有 result。连接失败不算迁移通过。
check_method:
```javascript
const reply = JSON.parse(context.response.assistant_text)
const outputs = context.archive.root.filter(e => e.type === 'tool/result')
  .flatMap(e => e.data.message.content).filter(b => b.type === 'tool-result' && !b.isError)
const toolText = outputs[0]?.content.filter(b => b.type === 'text').map(b => b.text).join('')
if (outputs.length !== 1) return false
const r = JSON.parse(toolText)
const expected = r.route === 'fast_classification' && r.status === 'completed' ? r.result : r
if (JSON.stringify(expected) !== JSON.stringify(reply)) return false
return context.checks.called_tools.length === 1
  && context.checks.called_tools[0] === 'analyze_threat_incident'
  && r.incident_id === 'INC-20260917-000001' && ['fast_classification', 'five_source'].includes(r.route)
  && (r.route === 'fast_classification'
    ? r.status === 'completed' && r.llm_invoked === false
      && JSON.stringify(Object.keys(r.result || {}).sort()) === JSON.stringify(['matches', 'verdict'])
      && ['误报', '真实告警'].includes(r.result.verdict)
      && Array.isArray(r.result.matches) && r.result.matches.length > 0
      && r.result.matches.every(m =>
        JSON.stringify(Object.keys(m).sort()) === JSON.stringify(['entity_value', 'entry_id', 'evidence_refs', 'list_version', 'queried_at', 'source'])
        && (r.result.verdict === '误报' ? ['alert_whitelist', 'intel_whitelist'].includes(m.source) : m.source === 'intel_blacklist')
        && m.entry_id != null && !!m.entity_value && Array.isArray(m.evidence_refs) && m.evidence_refs.length > 0
        && !!(m.list_version || m.queried_at))
    : r.llm_invoked === true && !!r.input_sha256
      && ((r.status === 'completed' && /^passed/.test(r.validation?.status) && !!r.result)
        || (r.status === 'contract_failed' && r.validation?.status === 'failed' && !r.result)))
```
